cohort: Antenatal women with singleton pregnancies who experienced vaginal bleeding within the first 14 weeks of gestation and presented to a tertiary care center in northern India.
finding: Although most pregnancies with first-trimester vaginal bleeding progress to term, early bleeding (before 8 weeks) significantly increases the risk of preterm labour and placental complications.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed in 47.8% of cases.
